'''James Boyd''' (also published as '''Jim Boyd''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 AugustaCon EPP Overdrive (Day 1)]] in October 2000 with DS War Room, according to Landon Sommer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1385">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-2-in-1-augustacon-from-a-loserd1385/ 2-in-1-augustacon-from-a-loser], DeckTech (Landon "Periculum" Sommer, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-2-in-1-augustacon-from-a-loserd1385/ GitHub Pages].</ref> James Boyd also played at [[2000 AugustaCon Constructed (Day 1)]] in October 2000 with X-wing swarm Hyper Escape with Draw Their Fire, according to Paul Myers's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1379">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-jabronicon-2000-pauld1379/ jabronicon-2000-paul], DeckTech (Paul "lbmyers1" Myers, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-jabronicon-2000-pauld1379/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
